pencereler.0-5: A single wire can black out an entire country. The power grid is one
pencereler.5-12: giant connected machine. Every line carries only so much before it overheats. When one line trips, its load jumps
pencereler.12-20: to the others. Now those lines are overloaded, so they trip too. In seconds, the failure cascades across the whole network. Millions
pencereler.20-30: of people go dark before anyone can react. Restarting a dead grid can take days of careful work. The whole system is only as strong as its weakest
